spans.s:
n. (-कं)
1 The heart, the mind.
2 Law, litigation.
E.
रिच to divide, &c., aff. क.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Empty, void.
2 Poor, indigent.
3 Unloaded, unburthened.
4 Purged.
n. (-क्तं)
1 A wood, a forest.
2 A vacuity, a vacuum.
f. (-क्ता)
The fourth, ninth, or fourteenth days of the lunar fortnight.
E.
रिच to void by stool, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Void, empty.
2 Unladen, unburthened.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ता)
Vacuity, void, space.
E.
रिक्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिक्तत्वं.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Having no vessels or effects.
n. (-ण्डं)
An empty vessel.
E.
रिक्त, and भाण्ड vessel.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Empty-handed.
E.
रिक्त, and हस्त hand.

n. (-क्यं)
Substance, property, wealth.
E.
रिच् to separate, Uṇādi aff. थक्.

mfn. (-री-रिनी-रि)
Taking or inheriting property.
m. (-री)
1 An heir, one who succeeds to the property of the deceased, and gives the funeral cake.
2 A maternal uncle.
3 The seed of the Indian fig.
E.
रिक्थ wealth, and हारिन् who takes.

mfn. (-क्थी-क्थिनी-क्थि)
Wealthy, possessing property.
m. (-क्थी)
A successor or an heir.
E.
रिक्थ wealth, and इनि aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 A nit.
2 A mote in a sun-beam.
E.
see लिक्षा, ल being changed to र.
